title: One entry of the root Figures list

name.description: Becomes the output filename, and the stable address for `jplot config set`.

enable.description: false skips this figure without removing it.

type.description: Figure-type shorthand expanded into layers before rendering. Run `jplot cap types` for the list.

style.description: Style card tokens, e.g. [a4paper_2x1, rect]. Run `jplot cap styles` for the catalog.

style_card.description: Alias of style for type: macros (posterior_2d / profile_2d).

frame.description: Per-axes frame settings merged over the style card: limits, scales, labels, ticks, legend, colorbar colour ownership.

data.description: type: macro dataset ref (DataSet.name) or inline source block. Expanded away before render.

x.description: type: macro x coordinate (expr / name / lim / scale).

colorbar.description: type: macro colorbar options merged into frame.axc.

share_data.description: type: macro share_data name for the expanded density/profile table.

extra_layers.description: Additional hand-written layers appended after type expansion.

pcolormesh.description: type: profile_2d style overrides for the pcolormesh layer.

voronoi.description: type: profile_2d style overrides for the voronoi layer.

debug.description: Draw the design-reference overlay showing every axes box and its dimensions.

legend.description: Not read here. The renderer only looks for a legend under frame.<axes>.legend.
